class Solver:
    def __init__(self, n, M):
        self.n = n
        self.M = M
        self.dp = [0]*(n+1)
        self.accu = [0]*(n+1)
        self.dp[1] = 1
        self.dp[2] = 1
        self.accu[1] = 1
        self.accu[2] = 2

    def solve(self):
        for i in range(3,self.n+1):
            self.dp[i] = self.accu[i-1]
            for j in range(1,int(i**0.5)+1):
                if i%j==0:
                    self.dp[i] += self.dp[j]
                    self.dp[i] = self.dp[i] % self.M
                    if j*j<i:
                        self.dp[i] += self.dp[i//j]
                        self.dp[i] = self.dp[i] % self.M
            self.accu[i] = (self.accu[i-1] + self.dp[i])%self.M

    def print_result(self):
        self.solve()
        print(self.accu[self.n])

n, M = map(int,input().split())
